A fragment anchor link is extracted into metadata.links when extract_metadata is true

```csharp title="C#"
using System;
using HtmlToMarkdown;

var result = HtmlToMarkdownConverter.Convert("<p>Jump to <a href=\"#section\">section</a> below.</p>", new ConversionOptions { ExtractMetadata = true });
Console.WriteLine(result.Content);
Console.WriteLine(result.Metadata.Links);
```
